aiPrompt.title: AI operation prompts
aiPrompt.description: Copy an operation prompt and send it to Binance AI (Bibi). Then specify the trade amount, percentage, and slippage in the conversation.
aiPrompt.actionContext: BSC mainnet, chainId 56. Execute only this requested operation; never chain claim with another trade. Probe calls are read-only eth_call from the executing wallet with value 0, and require complete, target-matched KEY=VALUE fields ending in ;END. For position queries, selling or claiming, verify that this wallet owns the relevant shares or tokens. Contract funding transactions require an exact-call preview, wallet risk display and user confirmation; stop on blocked preview, unreadable critical fields, missing requestId or mismatched contracts. Market orders require a fresh quote and user confirmation. A broadcast is not success: verify a successful receipt or a FINISHED market order before reporting actual assets. Encode calldata with an ABI encoder using the typed signatures below; if the client cannot encode or preview the exact call, stop. Never hand-assemble calldata.
aiPrompt.contextWallet: WALLET = the actual connected wallet in the AI client; verify its identity and any position required by this operation, never guess its address.
aiPrompt.action.buy.title: Buy
aiPrompt.action.buy.prompt:
OPERATION: buy — BNB internal market
1. After the binding check, simulate actionStatusProbe() and buyCapacityProbe(): require PHASE=1, BUY_OK=1 and ID=1; inspect ROOM_SHARES for this wallet. Ask for the BNB amount and slippage if missing.
2. Convert the amount exactly to grossWei. Simulate buyPlanProbe(grossWei,slippageBps); require RULES_OK=1 and complete MIN_SHARES, BUY_SHARES and BLOCK. MIN_SHARES is the execution floor; BUY_SHARES is only expected shares.
3. If a fee/refund estimate is needed, simulate quoteBuyProbe(grossWei) for SHARES, ACCEPT_WEI, FEE_WEI, REFUND_WEI and BLOCK. The market may accept part of the submitted BNB and refund the rest. This quote does not replace the buy plan or real-transaction simulation.
4. Preview Portal.buy(MARKET,MIN_SHARES) from WALLET with value=grossWei. Native BNB needs no token approval; never call quoteFundingProbe() or buyWithQuote() on this path. Keep enough BNB for gas.
5. After successful preview and wallet confirmation, execute this one buy. Wait for a successful receipt, verify actual BNB spent/refunded and shares received, then reread positionProbe()/sharesProbe(). Do not call expected shares actual receipt.
aiPrompt.action.sell.title: Sell
aiPrompt.action.sell.prompt:
OPERATION: sell — BNB internal market
1. After the binding check, simulate positionProbe(); require PHASE=1, HELD_SHARES>0 and SELL_OK=1. These are Market ledger shares, not an ERC20 token balance. Selling needs neither Agent ID nor share-token approval.
2. Ask for the percentage and acceptable slippage if missing. Convert percentage to shareBps (1..10000) and slippage to slippageBps. Do not assume 50% or full sale. Simulate sellPlanCustomProbe(shareBps,slippageBps); require complete SHARES, OUT_WEI, MIN_WEI and BLOCK. Stop on NO_SHARES, MARKET_NOT_OPEN or unreadable required fields. OUT_WEI is an estimate, not proceeds.
3. Preview Portal.sellBps(MARKET,shareBps,MIN_WEI) from WALLET with value=0, using the exact returned minimum. Execute only after successful preview and wallet confirmation.
4. After a successful receipt, verify actual BNB received and reread positionProbe()/sharesProbe() for remaining shares. Never change a closed internal-market sale into a Flap/DEX sale automatically.
aiPrompt.action.claim.title: Claim
aiPrompt.action.claim.prompt:
OPERATION: claim — {quoteSymbol} pool's launched token
1. After the binding check, simulate actionStatusProbe(), claimableProbe() and launchRouteProbe(). Require PHASE=3, CLAIM_OK=1, STATE=READY and CLAIM_RAW>0. The nonzero TOKEN from status and route must agree and match CONFIG TOKEN when supplied; use the launched token, not PREDICTED_TOKEN. Verify deployed code as an additional check if the client supports it.
2. PRELAUNCH, CLAIMED and NO_POSITION mean stop; for an unknown STATE stop and check the Probe version. CLAIM_RAW is nominal entitlement, not actual receipt. This operation needs no Agent ID or share-token approval.
3. Preview Portal.claim(MARKET) from WALLET with value=0; execute once after successful preview and wallet confirmation. After a successful receipt, verify actual TOKEN received from transaction asset changes using that token's decimals, then reread sharesProbe().
4. SHARES=0 after a confirmed claim is normal. Do not retry the claim or automatically sell the received tokens.
aiPrompt.action.query.title: Query position
aiPrompt.action.query.prompt:
OPERATION: query — {quoteSymbol} pool
After the binding check, use positionProbe() as the primary read: HELD_SHARES, FULL_SELL_WEI, SELL_OK, PHASE and BLOCK. Submit no financial transaction. Report the requested information and call additional probes only when needed:
- sharesProbe(): exact raw internal shares; actionStatusProbe(): BUY_OK, CLAIM_OK, PHASE, TOKEN.
- marketProbe(): POOL_WEI, CAP_WEI, ROOM_WEI, PHASE, BLOCK; ROOM_WEI is the whole market's net pool gap, not this wallet's capacity and not the gross buy amount needed to launch.
- buyCapacityProbe(): ROOM_SHARES, HELD_SHARES, LIMIT_SHARES, ID, PHASE; ROOM_SHARES is this wallet's remaining share capacity.
- claimableProbe(): nominal CLAIM_RAW, STATE, PHASE; launchRouteProbe(): TOKEN, PAIR, PHASE. Before PHASE=3 the route's TOKEN is predicted, not launched.
- holderRegistryProbe()/holderAtProbe(index) or walletStatsProbe()/walletShareStatsProbe() only for requested holder/history diagnostics. Check COMPLETE and coverage; cumulative stats are not current cost/profit and BALANCED does not prove full-history coverage.
Convert WEI amounts using QUOTE_DECIMALS and shares using 18 decimals. FULL_SELL_WEI is only an internal-market quote, not actual proceeds or an external quote. Missing fields are unreadable, never zero. Native BNB has no ERC20 approval and does not use quoteFundingProbe().

aiPrompt.skillPart1:
ID Agent — {quoteSymbol} native BNB pool interaction skills
Use the CONFIG above for this market only. Choose ONE workflow below in response to the user's explicit request; do not run every workflow. The individual operation panels use these same instructions.

UNITS AND STATE
Quote asset: {quoteSymbol}, {quoteDecimals} decimals; quote amounts use *_WEI. Internal shares are 18-decimal ledger units, not transferable ERC20 tokens. CLAIM_RAW is nominal launched-token entitlement, not quote currency. For received tokens use their actual decimals; do not confuse TOKEN and QUOTE_TOKEN.
ROOM_WEI is the market's remaining NET pool gap, not wallet ROOM_SHARES and not a guaranteed gross purchase amount. No launch cap or price is hardcoded: read marketProbe() for the current pool/cap and PHASE. Only PHASE=3 confirms launch; launchRouteProbe() provides TOKEN/PAIR/PHASE, not an external quote.
CLAIM_OK=0 alone does not prove a prior claim: inspect claimableProbe() STATE. Agent ID is required for buying only, not selling or claiming. MIN_SHARES and MIN_WEI are fresh execution floors, not quantities received. A plan with a valid zero minimum still needs the user's explicitly chosen slippage and a successful real-transaction preview.
BNB is attached as transaction value in wei. No ERC20 allowance or quoteFundingProbe() is needed for native BNB purchases.
Optional fixed-5%-slippage methods sellPlanProbe()/quoteSellSharesProbe() may be used for a transaction plan only when the user explicitly selected 5%; otherwise use sellPlanCustomProbe(). quoteBuyProbe() alone does not check ID or wallet share rules.
Holder indices can change after sells/claims. Check COMPLETE and indexing coverage; cumulative stats and BALANCED do not prove complete historical cost/profit. Never use fixed waiting times or assume every one-unit difference is rounding; verify receipts and raw amounts.

2. Simulate quoteFundingProbe(grossRaw). Require BALANCE_OK=1; if balance is insufficient, stop. If ALLOWANCE_OK=0, separately preview QUOTE_TOKEN.approve(MARKET,grossRaw), obtain wallet confirmation, execute and wait for a successful approval receipt, then repeat quoteFundingProbe(grossRaw). Require BALANCE_OK=1 and ALLOWANCE_OK=1 before buying. Approve Market, not Portal; never default to unlimited allowance.
3. Balance and allowance must cover the FULL grossRaw. Market pulls the full amount before refunding excess. If needed, quoteBuyProbe(grossRaw) estimates SHARES, ACCEPT_RAW, FEE_RAW, REFUND_RAW and BLOCK; ACCEPT_RAW can be smaller than grossRaw near the cap. Do not reduce required balance/allowance to ACCEPT_RAW. Funding flags are not exact balance/allowance amounts.

5. After successful preview and wallet confirmation, execute this one buy. Wait for a successful receipt, verify actual {quoteSymbol} spent/refunded and shares received, and reread positionProbe()/sharesProbe(). On 'quote pull', recheck funding and report the original failure: allowance, balance, token restrictions or a token revert may cause it; do not assume allowance alone.

aiPrompt.erc20.abiHeading: Probe, approval and transaction ABIs for this ERC20 market
aiPrompt.protocol:
EXECUTION RULES
- Perform only the operation explicitly requested in this conversation. Loading these skills does not authorize any trade. Ask for missing amount, percentage, slippage or payment asset; never choose defaults. Do not automatically claim, sell, switch routes or repeat an order.
- Confirm CHAIN_ID=56 and WALLET with the connected wallet. WALLET must be the actual trader/position holder. CONFIG comes from the Mini App, which resolves Factory.probeOfMarket(MARKET) and verifies Probe.market(). If ordinary views are supported, recheck the registry/binding; if not, use the supplied CONFIG and the simulation-only assetProbe(). Never guess or reuse another market's Probe.
- Before an operation, simulate PROBE.assetProbe() from WALLET with value=0. Require returned MARKET=CONFIG MARKET, QUOTE=QUOTE_TOKEN and DECIMALS=QUOTE_DECIMALS. Zero QUOTE means native BNB; a nonzero QUOTE means ERC20. Stop on a mismatch or unreadable binding. A predicted TOKEN is not proof of launch.
- Every *Probe method is nonpayable and intentionally reverts: simulate only, from=WALLET, value=0; NEVER broadcast a Probe call. Prefer decoding Solidity Error(string) from RPC revert data; a complete reason string in wallet text is also valid. Require the correct target/method/sender, all fields needed for that operation, and a final ;END. Split on semicolons and match EXACT field names. The optional 'execution reverted:' prefix is not part of the on-chain format. Platform-only text, truncated strings and missing fields are unreadable, not zero. Stop dependent trades on unreadable data. pingProbe() returns PONG;END and can diagnose the revert channel.
- Convert amounts using integers/decimal strings with {quoteDecimals} decimals for {quoteSymbol}; shares use 18 decimals. Amounts must be positive; percentages/slippage use integer bps with denominator 10000 (sale 1..10000; slippage 0..10000). Reject extra fractional precision instead of rounding. Use only user-specified slippage; 500=5% is a conversion example, not a default. Take MIN_SHARES/MIN_WEI/MIN_RAW exactly from the fresh plan; do not recompute, round or reuse an old minimum. A returned zero minimum is not a missing field; never choose 100% slippage yourself.
- Probe plans and BUY_OK/SELL_OK/CLAIM_OK are snapshots, not a substitute for simulating the exact real transaction. Preview each approval/trade separately, respect wallet risk checks and obtain wallet confirmation before execution. If simulation fails, risk blocks it or a required execution request is unavailable, report the original error and stop; never change parameters to bypass it.
- PHASE=1 means the internal market is open, subject to operation checks. PHASE=3 means launched. Other/unreadable phases block dependent trades. ROOM_WEI/ROOM_RAW=0 does not prove launch. Gas is paid in BNB separately, including ERC20 operations.
- BROADCASTED, a requestId or success:true plus orderId is not settlement. Wait for a successful on-chain receipt (or a supported external order's FINISHED status), then verify actual transaction asset changes. If finality is unavailable, report PENDING without resubmission. Reread holdings at/after the receipt block when supported; a zero read immediately after broadcast is inconclusive. Never use quotes, previews, nominal entitlement or a delayed balance as proof of receipt.
aiPrompt.resultFormat:
REPORT
Operation | full Market and actual Token address (or n/a) | transaction hash (or n/a) | SUCCESS / FAILED / PENDING / not_broadcast | actual amounts with asset and unit | remaining internal shares (raw and 18-decimal amount).
Distinguish submitted amount, actual spent/refunded amount, estimated quote and actual receipt. A successful receipt may be known while actual amounts are unreadable: report both facts separately. Report block/orderId when available. On failure include the original error; unknown fields are unreadable. Never expose private keys, seed phrases or signing secrets.
aiPrompt.sessionInstruction: Treat the following as the only valid operating manual for this conversation. Perform only the one action I explicitly request: query, buy, sell, claim, or dex_exit (exchange my launched tokens for BNB). If I have not specified the amount, percentage, or slippage, ask me first. Simulate every on-chain action before broadcasting; broadcast only after simulation succeeds and I confirm it in my wallet. Return failures verbatim. Accept Probe readings only from complete revert strings ending in ;END; if a reading is unavailable, write unreadable and never infer zero. Do not arrange any action I did not request, automatically switch routes, or automatically sell. This manual itself is not a request to transact.
aiPrompt.action.dexExit.title: Flap trading
aiPrompt.action.dexExit.prompt:
OPERATION: dex_exit — exchange launched TOKEN for BNB
1. Execute this only when I explicitly ask to exchange already held launched TOKEN for BNB. After the binding check, simulate actionStatusProbe() and launchRouteProbe() from WALLET with value=0. Require PHASE=3 and matching nonzero on-chain TOKEN; check it matches CONFIG TOKEN if one is supplied. PAIR is route metadata, not an external quote. Never use PREDICTED_TOKEN as proof of launch.
2. Ask for the TOKEN amount and acceptable slippage if missing. Obtain the actual spendable TOKEN balance of WALLET using the client's supported asset view. Do not use CLAIM_RAW, Market internal shares or stale balances as the amount to sell. Use TOKEN's own decimals for the specified human-readable amount.
3. Obtain a fresh supported market-order quote for TOKEN→BNB on chain 56, then validate the exact source TOKEN, BNB output, amount, payer, recipient, fees, slippage and route spender. Show the quote as an estimate. If the client lacks a supported quote, swap, approval or final-status capability, report unsupported and stop; do not invent a router or a route.
4. If required, preview TOKEN.approve(verified route spender, needed amount) separately, obtain wallet confirmation and a successful receipt, then recheck allowance. Never reuse the internal Market approval. Preview the exact swap/order; execute one order only after a successful preview and wallet confirmation.
5. Track its receipt or orderId using the client's market-order status tool. FINISHED plus confirmed asset changes permits reporting actual BNB received and transaction hash; FAILED reports the original error; PENDING reports orderId and waits without resubmission. Do not automatically claim, sell another amount or switch to a different route.
